messages.text: when will it be in your possession to ship them out

The B.4 drop is set for mid-October — we don't have a confirmed day yet. Once that stock lands it ships out from there.

Want me to put you on the notify list, or show you something you can buy today?
wjere will it 'land' and where do they ship out from?

It ships from our warehouse, and the plug is matched automatically to your shipping country — US for US/Canada, UK for Britain, EU otherwise.

Where would it be going? I can tell you what shipping looks like to you.

Delaware, good — US plug, no import VAT or duty, and shipping on drop-shipped units is a flat ladder by weight (most land at $30–$40).

The B.4 still isn't buyable until the mid-October drop. Want me to show you what's shipping now in that range — the Magic Miner 40T at $799, or the BC04 at $239?
if i order the magic miner when will it be shipped out to me

The live batch now is Batch 7 (50 units) at $799. Batch 6 was the Nov 21 one, so Batch 7 lands after that — I'd rather confirm the exact date than quote you an old one.

Want me to have the team confirm Batch 7's ship date, or look at something in stock that ships in 2–5 days?
the bs4 is dropped shipped from where does it originate

On drop-shipped units like the BS-4 we say it ships from our warehouse — we don't name the origin country on those, it's a rule we hold to on every listing.

What it does mean for you: US plug, no import VAT or duty into Delaware, and flat shipping by weight.
so the drop date is the first date we can order them dropshipped from where ever they come from (CN)

The drop date is just when units go on sale — first come, first served, no holds. The ship date is a separate line on the listing once the drop is live.

And I can't confirm an origin country for it either way. Anything else about the BS-4 I can get you?
